title: What It Actually Looks Like to Do Great Work and Take None of the Credit
caption:
A godly man does the job no one saw. Then he lets someone else get thanked for it.

Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord (Colossians 3:23). An audience of one changes what quality means to you.

The itch for credit is honest. Scratching it isn't required. Do the part nobody inspects. Let someone else get the win. Let the story stay wrong about you.

Great work and an empty hand. That's the whole trick.
